description: Selected focused dialog appearance and accessible header (REQ-016; C40, C41, C43; R81, R90, R91, R100, R104, R105, R106, R110, R113, R127, R131) delivered as the shared provider contract of the accepted focused logging dialog LoggingOverlay (src/ui/refinements/logging-overlay.tsx, created by TASK-018 from the accepted reference eded158cfd928d382c9a9409e2c372270312741d; recipe in src/ui/refinements/presentation.css over tokens.css; title contract src/ui/refinements/logging-overlay-context.ts adopted by the shared TimedResultLog): the selected simple form whose one title is the dialog's (a held log drops its own 'Log results' heading and is named by the dialog; inline it keeps its own), a header of the title then the framed icon-only X (the shared secondary IconButton named 'Close log', no visible Close word) aligned to the header's start with the title's line box trimmed to its capitals so the X's frame starts on the visible title top for one-line and wrapped titles including Workout feedback and a superset's Log round 1, the selected A / Balanced backdrop (--logging-backdrop-blur/-tint/-edge-tint, the reviewed values) on the native ::backdrop only with no filter, opacity or shadow on the foreground and no rising sheet, and native modal behaviour: showModal() making the workout behind inert while its clocks and the rest inside the log keep running, the X and Escape closing once through the consumer, focus returned to the opener, drafts kept across close/reopen. Checked at the shared-component boundary with representative consumers (the shared TimedResultLog's EMOM and twelve-round ladder logs, the actual MovementCountdown behind and inside the dialog, the shared FeelingRow in the gallery Workout feedback specimen) and the accepted gallery state /gallery/refinements?state=ladder-long. Provider acceptance only: no logging route has adopted the dialog (TASK-043–046 migrate consumers; TASK-041 owns full-route visual/geometry acceptance and JOURNEY-016 closure). Every declared case must execute and pass.
